issue: ${ARCH} is used (lines 90, 93) but never defined; under 'set -euo pipefail' the wgturn branch aborts the whole macOS build the moment wgturn-core resolves, and GOARCH="${ARCH}" would otherwise build a wrong/empty-arch binary.
fix: Define ARCH=arm64 before the wgturn block (matches '-r osx-arm64' on line 38). Assert the built binary's arch before bundling.

issue: appimagetool is wget'd from the mutable 'continuous' release tag with no checksum, then chmod +x and executed in the release build — a moving, unverified executable controls AppImage output.
fix: Pin appimagetool to a versioned release tag and verify a hardcoded sha256 before chmod/exec; fail closed on mismatch.

issue: libcronet.so is curl'd from the upstream sing-box release with no integrity check and bundled into every shipped Linux artifact (deb/AppImage/tar.gz); only the version string is pinned, not the tarball hash.
fix: Add a hardcoded sha256 of the sing-box tarball (or libcronet.so) and verify after download; exit 1 on mismatch.

issue: actions/upload-artifact@v4 (line 69) and signpath/github-action-submit-signing-request@v1 (line 75) use mutable tags while every other workflow SHA-pins; a tag-move could intercept the code-signing flow.
fix: Pin both actions to full commit SHAs to match repo convention before SignPath enrollment goes live.

issue: wgturn-core is cloned at floating HEAD (no pinned commit) and bundled into the macOS .app; the SHA is recorded (line 88) but never asserted, so a moved default branch ships arbitrary code.
fix: Pin WG_COMMIT and assert 'git rev-parse HEAD' equals it (as build-singbox-lx.ps1 Assert-GitHead does) before building.
